card.name: Inside -prazole drug names and PPI
card.fires_on: The ending pieces of proton pump inhibitor names such as pantoprazole, and of brexpiprazole or aripiprazole. Also the 'PI' in the abbreviation PPI.

modes.label: Ending of -prazole names
modes.description: The final piece of a drug name ending in -prazole, such as pantoprazole, brexpiprazole or aripiprazole.
modes.example: Examples Lansoprazole, pantopraz<<ole>> Drugs that Interfere with Entero

modes.label: PPI abbreviation
modes.description: The 'PI' piece of the abbreviation PPI when it is split into pieces, before the word therapy.
modes.example: Patients should use the lowest dose and shortest duration of P<<PI>> therapy appropriate to the condition being treated.

card.plain: It lights up near the end of drug names like pantoprazole and aripiprazole, and on the abbreviation PPI.
